THIRD-PARTY NOTICES
Current Compass reproduction application

1. THE IEEE 39-BUS SYSTEM WITH INVERTER-BASED RESOURCES (Wang and Chen)

The simulated network and its frequency-control design are the published system of:
  X. Wang and X. Chen, "Distributed Coordination of Grid-Forming and Grid-Following Inverters for
  Optimal Frequency Control in Power Systems," IEEE Transactions on Power Systems,
  doi:10.1109/TPWRS.2026.3684791. Preprint arXiv:2411.12682.
Upstream project: https://github.com/Xiaoyang-Wang-TAMU/IEEE39BusSystemwithIBR
Upstream commit:  b31d62ae731bfbc0290636fdbc1350d2fac0d206 (2026-07-20)
The model of the paper's runs was rebuilt in Simscape Electrical from that design; the paper (Section IV)
states how it departs from the authors' design and published model.
